title: 26 Lithia & Driveway Dealerships Named Among Automotive News’ 2026 Best Dealerships to Work For
summary: 26 Lithia & Driveway Dealerships Named Among Automotive News’ 2026 Best Dealerships to Work For
body_markdown:
*– Audi Millburn and Audi Coral Springs claim top two overall U.S. positions*


*– 18 U.S. and eight Canadian dealerships recognized for workplace culture and employee experience*


MEDFORD, Ore., Nov. 10, 2026[(GLOBE NEWSWIRE)](https://www.globenewswire.com/) -- Lithia & Driveway (NYSE: LAD) today announced that 26 of its dealerships across the United States and Canada have been named among Automotive News’ 2026 Best Dealerships to Work For. Lithia & Driveway dealerships claimed the top two overall U.S. rankings, with Audi Millburn in Maplewood, New Jersey earning the No. 1 spot, followed by Audi Coral Springs in Coral Springs, Florida at No. 2. The award program highlights dealerships that demonstrate a strong commitment to employee engagement, workplace culture, and team member development.


The recognition reflects Lithia & Driveway’s Growth Powered by People philosophy and its belief that strong teams are fundamental to long-term business performance. Lithia & Driveway focuses on developing leaders, creating opportunities for team members, and building an environment where employees can do their best work and deliver memorable customer experiences.


"Our store and support team members are the foundation of our business, and their commitment to our customers and the communities we serve is what sets Lithia & Driveway apart," said Bryan DeBoer, Chairman and CEO. "We're proud to see our dealerships recognized for the environments their teams and leaders have built. When we invest in our people, we're building stronger teams, deeper customer relationships, and a stronger business for the long term. A special congratulations to the teams at Audi Millburn and Audi Coral Springs on earning top recognitions, a direct reflection of their commitment to earning customers for life.”

**About Lithia & Driveway (LAD)**
Lithia & Driveway (NYSE: LAD) is the largest global automotive retailer making Auto Done Easy by providing simple, transparent, and convenient experiences throughout the ownership lifecycle. LAD helps customers take care of any vehicle need through a comprehensive network of physical locations, e-commerce platforms, captive finance solutions, fleet management offerings, and other synergistic adjacencies. Celebrating 80 years in business in 2026, LAD consistently delivers profitable growth in a massive and unconsolidated industry. Its highly diversified and competitively differentiated design provides LAD with the flexibility and scale to pursue its vision to modernize personal transportation solutions wherever, whenever and however consumers desire.
